reason: The hypothesis combines the well-known idea of domain wall pinning by nanoscale heterogeneities (from P8, P11, P12, P28) with the magnetocaloric effect in a specific new alloy system (FeMnNiGeSi HEA thin films/nanoribbons) and explicitly links pinning to the broadening of the magnetic entropy change and hysteresis under low-field, rate-limited cycling. While the individual elements are taken from the literature, the integration of these mechanisms to explain the magnetocaloric response in this low-dimensional, non-equiatomic HEA system, and the proposed test of annealing to reduce pinning and sharpen the entropy change, goes beyond what any single passage proposes.
